info.title: SpecKitFinex Exchange API
info.description: Design contract for Spring Boot4.1.0/JDK21 single-instance memory mode. api.md and feature spec supply normative business invariants and code precedence. Every GET works without a body or Content-Type/Accept header. Every app-generated response uses the common envelope; malformed transport with no response remains outside that guarantee. Internal base is /internal; participant resources are directly at root; only GET/status is public. Internal matching precedes root matching. HTTP outcome policy2.0: handled application rejections return HTTP200 with success=false; request/security/system failures retain4xx/5xx. Clients must inspect the envelope. All responses include Cache-Control:no-store.

BookPrice.name: price
BookPrice.description: Supply together with side; exact price lookup, no tick rounding.

PositiveDecimalInput.description: Exact positive decimal string <=1000000000; at most 6 fractional digits; numeric JSON tokens are invalid.

Timestamp.description: Real valid calendar instant, English month abbreviations, UTC, dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm:ss.SSS.

Symbol.description: Trim then uppercase with Locale.ROOT before validating/looking up; normalized symbol remains reserved after deletion.

Password.description: ASCII secret; never returned or logged.

SymbolInput.description: Trim and uppercase before normalized-symbol validation/duplicate lookup; normalized length1-32.
